QuestInfo.name: Aran, the Polearm Warrior
QuestInfo.0: Apparently, a hero's weapon can recognize its owner, which means the weapon would react the moment you touched it... if you were indeed the hero that wielded a polearm, that is. You should head to town and click on #b#p1201001##k.
QuestInfo.1: The moment you touch the #p1201001#, you feel memories flood through you, but you aren't sure if you're really reminiscing or just imagining things. But wait, hold on. Is someone trying to talk to you?
QuestInfo.2: You remembered a time when you held the weapon, flashbacks of gripping the polearm in your two hands... Yes, you were Aran, the warrior that wielded the polearm to perfection.

default.0: If touching the polearm brought back some memories, you should talk to the Spirit of Polearm.
